editorial:
You follow Destiny, a young stripper trying to make ends meet, as she meets Ramona, a confident veteran who takes her under her wing. Together with a crew of friends, they start drugging wealthy Wall Street clients and running up their credit cards after the 2008 financial crash. The movie mixes flashy club scenes with real friendship and tough choices, giving you a fun but serious look at women fighting to survive in a world that never gave them a fair shot.

Jennifer Lopez steals every scene she is in, and the chemistry between the cast feels natural and warm. The pacing moves quickly, though some middle sections drag a little. If you enjoy crime stories with heart and strong female leads, this one is worth your time.
endingExplained: Destiny agrees to talk to journalist Elizabeth and admits everything the crew did. Ramona is arrested and charged, while Destiny gets a lighter sentence for cooperating. In the final scene, Destiny visits Ramona, who hands her the famous fur coat as a sign of forgiveness. They share a quiet moment that shows their bond survived the betrayal, even though their criminal run is over. The movie ends on a bittersweet note about loyalty, money, and the cost of getting ahead.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime stories with strong female leads and real heart.
